# T-1: Coupon SAVE10 takes 10% off

Start URL: http://localhost:8091/
Landmark: Your cart

## Acceptance criteria

### Apply SAVE10
Type SAVE10 in the coupon field and click Apply.
Verify the order total shows $27.50.

## Notes

The SAVE10 code went out on our flyer last week, and customers say the cart will not take it.
It should take 10% off the items. Shipping stays as it is.
